How I choose the stack

WooCommerce can fit a WordPress-managed catalog. Medusa and PostgreSQL can fit a headless project with custom workflows. Astro or Next.js may serve the storefront when they suit the editing and checkout requirements. I confirm the payment, tax, shipping and inventory responsibilities before implementation.
